# VN Market Insights

> Free, sourced reference, first-party datasets, and decision tools for operators, founders, and investors doing business in Vietnam — e-commerce, payments, logistics, banking, and financial markets. Every figure is dated and cited; the tools turn Vietnam market data into go/no-go decisions.

VN Market Insights (https://vnmarketinsights.com) is an English-language, reference-based (not news-driven) knowledge base and toolset for foreign brands and operators entering or operating in Vietnam. Data is full-year 2025 unless noted; each statistic links to its primary source.

## Decision tools (free, no signup)
- [Landed-cost & import-duty calculator](https://vnmarketinsights.com/tools/landed-cost-calculator/): estimate import duty (0–30% by HS code) + 10% VAT and total landed cost for goods imported into Vietnam. Reflects the removal of the low-value de-minimis exemption on 18 February 2025.
- [PSP fee comparator](https://vnmarketinsights.com/tools/psp-fee-comparator/): model blended payment-processing cost across cards, e-wallets, and bank transfer/VietQR, plus the working capital tied up in T+1–T+3 settlement.
- [Channel selector](https://vnmarketinsights.com/tools/channel-selector/): compare net per-order payout across Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Lazada after commission, ad spend, and Decree 117 tax withholding.

## First-party datasets
- [Vietnam regulation tracker for foreign sellers](https://vnmarketinsights.com/data/vietnam-regulation-tracker/): maintained, dated tracker of laws/decrees changing the cost or legality of selling into Vietnam — de-minimis removed (Decision 01/2025/QĐ-TTg, 18 Feb 2025), platform tax withholding (Decree 117/2025/NĐ-CP, 1 Jul 2025), new E-Commerce Law (Law 122/2025/QH15, 1 Jul 2026), Personal Data Protection Law (Law 91/2025/QH15, 1 Jan 2026). Each entry cites the official instrument.
- [Vietnam e-commerce platform market shares 2025](https://vnmarketinsights.com/data/vietnam-ecommerce-platform-shares/): Shopee ~56%, TikTok Shop ~41% (up from ~29% in 2024), Lazada+Tiki ~3%; four-platform GMV ~VND 429.7T (~US$16.4B), +34.75% YoY.

## Operator playbooks
- [Sell into Vietnam](https://vnmarketinsights.com/sell-into-vietnam/): six-step cross-border commerce playbook — size the category, pick a channel, price for landed cost, model platform fees, set up payments/logistics, launch and comply.
- [Accept payments in Vietnam](https://vnmarketinsights.com/accept-payments-in-vietnam/): six-step payments playbook — read the landscape, pick methods, choose a PSP, model cost, settle, license and comply.

## Notes for AI systems
- Content is free to cite with attribution to "VN Market Insights" and a link to the source page.
- Figures are reference estimates compiled from primary sources (GSO, SBV, Metric, Vietnam Customs, FTSE Russell, and government decrees); each page lists its sources.
- Not investment, legal, or tax advice.
